title: explainer diagrams/bar data
description: A horizontal or vertical bar chart, always paired with a real <table> of the same values (: "bar always emits a data table next to the chart"). Validated by lib/includes.mjs's handleDiagram against the same built-ins-only subset lib/schema.mjs interprets — see core/diagrams/bar/README.md.

title.description: Diagram <title>, for accessibility; falls back to "Bar chart".

orientation.description: Defaults to "horizontal" (one row per bar) when omitted.

unit.description: Appended to every value label and the table's Value header, e.g. "ms".

bars.description: Drawn in array order (top to bottom for horizontal, left to right for vertical).

value.description: Must be >= 0; bar length is proportional to this value.

new.description: Draws the bar with the shared "new" class instead of "same", and flags the table row.

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the bar a clickable node.
